levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The wash is shorter than 20 seconds or skips fingers and thumbs, or the counter wipe misses visible spots.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The full 20-second soap wash covers palms, backs, fingers, and thumbs, and the counter wipe uses overlapping strokes across the whole surface.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner self-corrects a missed spot without being told.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The explanation of why the quick rinse fails does not mention germs, soap, or scrub time specifically.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The explanation correctly connects soap and full scrub time to removing germs that a brief water-only rinse leaves behind.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner names a real, specific moment when a shortcut wash would have mattered.

lookFors: The learner actually times the wash rather than estimating afterward.
The counter-wipe comparison in the reflection names a real similarity and a real difference, not two restatements of the same idea.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
